description_text:
Suzuki Jimny
Lowpoly model of japanese small offroad car

Suzuki Jimny is a series of four-wheel drive off-road mini SUVs, manufactured and marketed by Japanese automaker Suzuki since 1970. Originally belonging to the kei class, Japan’s light automobile tax/legal class. Suzuki has marketed almost 3 million Jimnys in 194 countries. All four Jimny generations have separate frame and body. The body has no structural carrying role. It serves only as a cabin to protect the occupants from the elements, provide comfort, and protect them in the case of a crash. All four Jimny generations have dependent suspension (solid-beam axles) both at the front and rear axles. This used to be a common suspension design for all-terrain vehicles up to 1990s, but has become a rarity in vehicle design in the 21st century.

3 cars in set: Basic model + flat shaded model + tuned version. Each with own texture.

Check also my other aircrafts and cars

description_text:
Since 1931 Porsche has produced luxury sport cars, sedans, and SUVs for an adoring public. They have managed to become one of the top manufacturers of high-end vehicles in the world, but this reputation, and its follow-through, hasn’t happened by accident. It is the result of years of creating quality and keeping up with the latest and greatest automotive technology. Heck, in many cases that have been on the delivery end of that particular stick. What we mean by ‘little things’ is basically this: What are the little touches, extras, and various options does Porsche offer that takes the vehicles they make out of the proverbial box and set them right on center stage? Many things, believe us, many; you are likely very aware of a lot of them, if you are a fan of the Porsche brand at all. With all of the little extras in mind, we thought we would point our spotlight on one in particular, and our choice may surprise you. We didn’t choose a Porsche engine or transmission, or one of their knockout body styles. We didn’t choose the plush interior or loaded infotainment system…not really, anyway. Heck, we didn’t even choose to titter over added safety measures. In a way, however we chose to touch base here and there on all of them.

description_text:
These features were paired with low weight and thus lower unsprung masses compared with steel wheels. The lower the unsprung masses, the lower the moment of inertia and the better the handling. Consequently, the Type 35 was easier and more precise to steer, it braked better and the suspension was more comfortable than comparable racing cars of the time. During these early races, which often lasted several hours or even days, drivers were thus able to drive for longer, reach higher speeds and be more concentrated at the wheel. A reason why Bugatti drivers dominated the world’s race tracks between 1925 and 1930. Even today, the Type 35 does not ask too much of its drivers.
Bugatti produced seven different types of aluminium wheels over the next few years. For the Type 35, Type 39 and Type 51 racing cars, the French company produced three different versions: a 20-inch variant featuring small brakes, a 19-inch design with large brakes and 19-inch drop centre rims featuring large brakes. The cast wheels with eight wide aluminium spokes became Bugatti’s signature feature in addition to the horseshoe-shaped radiator grille. The design was also used for Bugatti’s first hyper sports car of modern times, the Veyron as the Veyron Fbg par Hermès special model.

description_text:
A break Disc composed by 4 diferent components, assembly in Catia V5 and rendered in Keyshot. All files included.
A disc brake is a type of brake that uses the calipers to squeeze pairs of pads against a disc or a rotor to create friction. This action slows the rotation of a shaft, such as a vehicle axle, either to reduce its rotational speed or to hold it stationary. The energy of motion is converted into waste heat which must be dispersed.
Hydraulically actuated disc brakes are the most commonly used form of brake for motor vehicles, but the principles of a disc brake are applicable to almost any rotating shaft. The components includes the disc, master cylinder, caliper (which contains cylinder and two brake pads) on both side of the disc.

description_text:
Asset BreakdownThe Overall ConceptThis premium vehicular asset is expertly engineered for modern arcade racing games, summer-themed open worlds, and high-fidelity driving simulators. Representing a luxury high-performance sports car with a distinct, custom beachside livery, this model serves as an exceptional Hero-Asset for player garages, special seasonal event unlocks, or high-end environmental set dressing. It delivers a highly dynamic, eye-catching visual presence while maintaining optimized geometry for seamless integration into real-time engines.
Vibrant Coastal Livery and Gloss FinishThe sports car features a striking, scenic aesthetic meticulously textured with professional-grade PBR materials. The primary chassis simulates a premium gloss-coated wrap depicting crashing ocean waves, detailed white sea foam across the hood, and a golden sandy beach blending along the lower side panels and rocker guards. This artistic exterior contrasts perfectly against a solid black roof panel, blacked-out multi-spoke alloy rims, and sleek side mirrors, providing a clear visual narrative of an elite, custom-styled sports vehicle.
Opaque Black Windows and Optimized OpticsAdhering strictly to professional optimization standards, the entire greenhouse cabin glass assembly—including the front windshield, side windows, and rear glass—as well as the prominent oval headlight lenses are modeled using solid, opaque black geometry with a high-gloss specular finish. This completely eliminates the heavy performance cost of complex interior cabin rendering, dashboard modeling, and refractive transparency, keeping the asset exceptionally lightweight without sacrificing its high-end look.
Sleek Aerodynamic SilhouetteThe unit is characterized by its low-slung, aerodynamic sports profile, featuring aggressive front air intakes, curved muscular fenders, and large low-profile racing tires. The structural configuration is instantly readable, offering excellent visual clarity as a fast, agile luxury vehicle. The asset is meticulously structured to present a flawless front three-quarter perspective, ensuring premium visual impact and a 100% frame-fill presence in your marketplace renders or garage-selection UI screens.
Optimized Game-Ready GeometryBuilt specifically for real-time engine performance, the model features a highly optimized footprint suitable for PC, console, and mobile racing titles. From the smooth, sweeping organic curves of the streamlined bodywork to the clean, sharp edge-flow of the blacked-out alloy wheels, all components are engineered for maximum efficiency. The mesh is logically constructed, allowing developers to easily rig the front steering rotation, individual wheel spins, and apply dynamic lighting reflections in engines like Unreal Engine and Unity.
Technical NotesFiles Included: FBX, GLB, OBJ, STL, Optimized PBR Texture Maps (4K).
Game-Engine Ready: The main vehicle chassis and all four high-performance wheels are logically separated as distinct meshes with correct, centered pivot points, allowing for immediate integration of arcade vehicle physics and wheel animations.
Quick Tip: Take full advantage of the high-gloss body paint and opaque windows by maximizing the environment's reflection probes or setting up sharp directional sunlight. The specular highlights moving across the ocean-wave graphics will look incredibly vibrant under coastal or sunny midday race conditions.

description_text:
4K - PBR Antique Wooden Nightstand - UE4 Ready low-poly 3d model ready for Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), games and other real-time apps.
Here is a game ready vintage windsor-styled wooden chair with the utmost care to obtain a standard that is both visually exquisite and performance friendly for real-time applications.
Each texture set comes with both the original TIFF format textures (Uncompressed) as well as their TGA equivalents, for use in a game engine (UE4/Unity).
All the texture maps adhere to the following naming convention:

  - *_BASE (The Color/Base/Albedo Map) 

  - *_NRM (The Normal Map - DirectX - Invert Green Channel for OpenGL) 

  - *_ROUGH (The Roughness/Microsurface Map) 

  - *_AO (The Ambient Occlusion Map) 

  - *_ARM (A map containing the previously mentioned AO, Roughness, and Metallic maps into each of the images individual channels of a single image. Conserving texture memory in certain applications (UE4 for example.) The ARM suffix corresponds to RGB in that:

Red Channel = Ambient Occlusion Green Channel = Roughness Map Blue Channel = Metallic Map

description_text:
Dome Zero RL80 Low poly renderableFormats included: OBJ, FBX, Marmoset, Max 
Japanese concept and racing car. PBR and Smooth ready.
This is not a printable model 
If you have any questions please don’t hesitate to contact me. I will respond you ASAP. I encourage you to check my other 3D models.
En 1976 Minoru Hayashi  tenía la idea de crear un pequeño súper coche que fuese capaz de competir en las 24 horas de Le Mans. El proyecto fue adquirido por Dome Co. Ltd, pero nunca llegaron a cumplir los requisitos para ser homologado en Japón como vehículo de calle. Con enfoque en USA, numerosas empresas de juguetes llegaron a un acuerdo con la compañía para crear miniaturas del modelo. (Dome Zero era el vehículo en el que se transformaba Rodimus Prime un sustituto fallido de Optimus).Con estos ingresos para la compañía, por fin Minoru Hayashi pudo ver cumplido su sueño de crear una versión que compitiera en las 24 horas de Le Mans. En 1979 no consiguió acabar la carrera, en 1980 lo hizo en el último lugar.

description_text:
3D printable chassis 1:32 scale slot car chassis to sit under the Miller Meteor available elsewhere.
The chassis has been designed to accommodate a standard motor, running inline.
The guide post will accommodate a Slotting Plus guide.
Print body at 199.2mm long. Do not scale width/height.
Chassis can be printed at 0.28mm layer height. On an Ender3 Pro this takes approximately two hours.
Build surface supports are recommended for the rear of the chassis, which is elevated in comparison to the front.
Included is the chassis, a brace for the motor and rear axle. These screw in place with M2.4mm screws (untapped holes are 2mm in diameter - this is also true for the grub screw holes on the front axle).
With regards to body fitment, apply the standard methods; posts or braces as you see fit on the chassis.
0.2 layer height is fine, but 0.12 is naturally better.
Recommend supports for the tail and running boards, and a raft to ensure the flag post doesn't lift

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 40
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 39
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl

The Celtic symbol of love and eternity
A coin with great meaning, perfect to give to your partner or children as a symbol of eternal love. Also, it is an excellent decorative object.

The Perenne knot is a Celtic symbol that represents eternal love. It is a knot that can not be undone and that has no beginning or end, so it was used to concretize the infinite union of a couple. In each generation, parents give this symbol to their children, to perpetuate their lineage.

description_text:
Why Do you need to buy this 3D model ?
I modeled and created this Car Back Bench to Impala 1967, but it's not 100 % similar to original one, so this seat can be use in any classic vehicle because is a very commun design and will add an air of simplicity  in any composition of sort. 
And also I created 3 collections of PBR options painted textures for Low Poly to add a pinch of lifetime realism for this model to really suits well in everywere that you do and I included materials also in the docs.
There are 3 ways to use it and one of these It's going to fits well in any game engine and real time renders because it's very low poly with good normals and nice topoligy, no ngons or trianguls that allows you to modifie preatty easy the mesh and the normals are fine and will be more easy to put modifiers such subdivision also. And only in the 3DSMax and Blender doc you already have crease on the edges to make easy to use OpenSubdivisions without the need to slide edges. So I creted 2 options of use for who works with reytrace renders or use in game engines with textures maps istead and all with 4K and 2K resolution that I baked and will brings the same qualitie with no subdivion and not only that, if you don't want to use subdivision I included High Poly mesh in the file.
( I just don't recommend to use the PBR textures in High Poly Meshe, because as you can see in the imagens both have diferent topology and there is not UV in the High Poly also.) 
And the object has proper pivot points locations to make it easy and precise to put in any place, and also easy to move and animate the open.
Resume everything, you are going to buy It's a model that can be use and reused and It will fits in anything that you make it without trouble and saving thousands of time.
More Details

  - Comes with low poly and high Poly meshes, 2 Docs ( Blender and 3DSMax 2021/2018), 3 presets of PBR Textures and 4 materials in the doc files

  - Clean topology and optimized geometry

  - Good heirarchy and rename objects

  - All UVs unwrapped and there is not overlapping

I hope you enjoy and for any problems, wishs or questions just contact me in the comments.

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 39
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 50
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl 
[Options]Car Body: Mid Size 4 door sedan
Engine: (Engine block can be removed to simulate an electric car, the mechanical parts under the hood will remain)V6
Sport pack:Yes (Rear wheels wider than front wheels, Wider body, Larger wheels, Larger engine with more cilinders, Upgraded hood, Larger brakes with red calipers, Added front and rear bumper lips and sideskirts, Flat bottom steering wheel)
Front bumper:Tier 7
Rear bumper:Tier 5
Dashboard:Tier 2
Exhaust:Tier 1
Wheels:Tier 1
Glass Roof:Yes
Seats:Comfort Seats
Executive rear seats with table and screens:No
Trim Color:Glossy chrome
Interior Leather Color:White
Tinted Rear Windows:Yes
Wheel Color:Grey

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 38
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 50
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl 
[Options]Car Body: Extended Wheelbase 4 door coupe
Engine: (Engine block can be removed to simulate an electric car, the mechanical parts under the hood will remain)V6
Sport pack:NoYes (Rear wheels wider than front wheels, Wider body, Larger wheels, Larger engine with more cilinders, Upgraded hood, Larger brakes with red calipers, Added front and rear bumper lips and sideskirts, Flat bottom steering wheel)
Front bumper:Tier 11
Rear bumper:Tier 4
Dashboard:Tier 1
Exhaust:Tier 1
Wheels:Tier 5
Glass Roof:Yes
Seats:Sport Seats
Executive rear seats with table and screens:YesNo
Trim Color:Glossy black
Interior Leather Color:White
Tinted Rear Windows:No
Wheel Color:Alloy

description_text:
Highly engineered carbon racing machines, stylish steel retro bikes and every bike in between: They can not do without the perfect tires. Pick your tire from the 4 ring models and wear it as a ring. Three variants have a tread, one ring is a slick. Because of their small width, the rings can even be stacked, so you can wear several on one finger.  
Dimensions and details of the ring profile: The ring cross-section is (wide x high) 3.5x4mm. The tire tread is 0.6mm thick and the finest part runs out in 0.14mm width. This makes the model perfect for testing and calibrating your 3D printer. Because of the fine details, the model does not comply with the design guides of the suppliers of the lost wax metal casting. If you insist on casting it anyway, you will have to expect softened details in the final casting. It is best to ask the supplier for an estimate. The rings are ring size 58, if you need a different ring size you can scale the model.
As a trained goldsmith with years of experience in 3D design, I work with great care. If something does not fit, please feel free to contact me.
If my designs inspire you contact me for your personal ideas.

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 36
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 46

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 32
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 46
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl 
[Options]Car Body: Extended Wheelbase 2 door coupe
Engine: (Engine block can be removed to simulate an electric car, the mechanical parts under the hood will remain)V8
Sport pack:No

Exhaust:Tier 3
Wheels:Tier 2
Glass Roof:Yes
Seats:Comfort Seats
Executive rear seats with table and screens:Yes
Trim Color:Glossy chrome
Interior Leather Color:Black
Tinted Rear Windows:No
Wheel Color:Black

description_text:
Universal joint, fully functional, accurately modeled, and ready for use in CAD, CGI, and 3D print applications. Modeled in Autodesk Inventor and provided in multiple file formats. Perfect for both digital and physical mechanical design projects.
Universal joints are used to couple two rotating shafts that are not parallel. They are commonly used with automobile drive shafts, steering columns, and a variety of industrial equipment.
Universal joint specifications:

  - Shaft diameter: 1.000in

  - Outside diameter: 1.500in

  - Overall length: 4.000in

  - Maximum operarting angle: 30.0deg

3 Provisions are included to mount the universal joint to your shafts:

  - Keyway cut into bore

  - Thru hole for spring pins

  - Pilot hole that can be drilled and tapped to accept set screws

Universal joint is sized for a 1.000in diameter shaft. But parts can be easily scaled to use with any shaft diameter of your choice, in imperial or metric dimensions.
Scaling factors for common shaft sizes:

  - 1.000in shaft = 100% scale

  - 0.750in shaft = 75% scale

  - 0.500in shaft = 50% scale

  - 0.250in shaft = 25% scale

  - 25mm shaft = 98.43% scale

  - 20mm shaft = 78.74% scale

  - 15mm shaft = 59.06% scale

  - 10mm shaft = 39.37% scale

Native Autodesk Inventor 2012 files are provided with intact browser trees and parameter tables to allow full configurability and customization.
Product includes:

  - 3 Autodesk Inventor 2012 part files for CAD (IPT format) - includes fork, block, and pin

  - 2 Autodesk Inventor 2012 assembly files for CAD (IAM format) - includes finished assembly and exploded assembly

  - 1 Autodesk Inventor 2012 drawing file for CAD (IDW format)

  - 5 STP models for CAD - includes finished assembly, exploded assembly, fork, block, and pin

  - 5 SAT models for CAD - includes finished assembly, exploded assembly, fork, block, and pin

  - 5 IGS models for CAD - includes finished assembly, exploded assembly, fork, block, and pin

  - 3 STL models for 3D print - fork, block, and pin

  - 1 OBJ model for CGI - includes finished assembly

  - 1 3DS model for CGI - includes finished assembly

  - 1 FBX model for CGI - includes finished assembly

  - 2 Viewable, read-only 3d models (DWF format, open using Autodesk Design Review free download) - includes finished assembly and exploded assembly

  - 1 Detail drawing (DWG format)

  - 1 Detail drawing (PDF format)

description_text:
Mach Landerfrom The Brave Fighter of Legend Da-Garnreplica
[en]
archive contains 2 folders:

  - a folder with the full set of print-ready parts which were redesigned to make the assembly easier

  - a folder with the full set of print-ready parts which are fully compatible with the original toy

assembly.pdfhttps://drive.google.com/open?id=1nYAOFWsF0xjRABj437lHOQGjeY5yat7w
to assemble the toy you will need some additional things which you can see on the attached image (for more details please download assembly.pdf):

  - 2 pins which contain small nails which are suitable to hold front wheels

  - 2 metal spikes 2.2x29mm and 2.2x51mm (hard 2.2mm metal wire will be ok)

  - an M3 screw (3x18mm) and a nut for it

  - 7 pieces of 5.5mm screws

  - 2 screws with a wide head, 5mm long

recommended printing settings:

  - every part already has the correct position for printing (the main part will have a lot of support but it is necessary to print the face of the toy correctly and avoid any skewing, if the main part will be somehow skewed. then other parts will look misplaced after the assembly)

  - it was tested in ABS and PLA

  - layer height: 0.1

  - infill density: 5%

  - support: only touching buildplate

  - support pattern: Concentric

  - support density: 20%

  - buildplate adhesion type: raft

[ru]
архив содержит 2 папки:

  - папка с полным набором деталей, некоторые из которых изменены (отличаются от оригинальной игрушки) для более удобной сборки вручную

  - папка с полным набором деталей, полностью совместимымых с оригинальной игрушкой

инструкция по сборке (assembly.pdf)https://drive.google.com/open?id=1nYAOFWsF0xjRABj437lHOQGjeY5yat7w
для сборки версии с изменёнными деталями понадобятся

  - 2 кнопки, внутри которых содержатся маленькие гвоздики, идеально подходящие под передние колёса

  - 2 металлических стержня 2.2x29мм и 2.2x51мм (подойдёт алюминиевая проволока 2.2мм)

  - винтик М3 (3x18мм) и гайка к нему

  - 7 шурупов 5.5мм

  - 2 шурупа или винтика с широкой шляпкой, длина 5мм

рекомендованные настройки печати:

  - все детали уже в подготовленной для печати позе (у детали main.stl, к сожалению, будет много поддержки, но это необходимо для того, чтобы лицо игрушки напечаталось нормально, и чтобы избежать искривления основоной части, тк в противном случае остальные детали будут иметь большие зазоры)

  - модель протестирована на ABS и PLA пластике

  - layer height: 0.1

  - infill density: 5%

  - support: only touching buildplate

  - support pattern: Concentric

  - support density: 20%

  - buildplate adhesion type: raft

This plugin comes by default with blender and its also really famous
